hypothesis: The published 0.25-0.278 plateau is not geology: the nine focus rasters are one regional density field (pairwise block-density Spearman 0.996-0.999) scored by dot count and catalogue-collar fraction alone. Fixing the one measurable inefficiency - 14% of true-positive credit lost to redundant dot packing - raises the score at the same budget.
mechanism: DTI = TP/(0.2*FP + 0.8*N + 0.2*TP) with FN = N - TP exactly and FP <= D, so at fixed budget D the only term placement can raise without bound is TP = sum_cells prior * max_dot k. Published packing is kmass/dot = 8.02-8.27 for the seven rasters at D <= 42k and 6.56-6.58 for the two 60k rasters against a geometric maximum of 9.38, i.e. 12-30% of available TP is discarded to overlapping dots. A weighted Poisson-disk placement (5 px separation) reaches 9.365. Removing the 3 px catalogue collar removes dots whose measured marginal cost is 1.9-3.0x that of an ordinary dot.
named_non_fault_process_that_could_mimic: Survey flight-line and radiometric leveling artefacts, and detrended-elevation edge effects, produce linear features that look like faults. The blocking fields (mineral/geothermal alteration) also project as lineaments. This design adds NO feature-driven lineament claim, so it cannot be fooled by them - but it also cannot benefit from real ones.

submission_note: H3-PACK: collar-free, max-packing dot field; 34000 dots; no hidden label used

projection.assumption: regression fitted on the eight dotted focus rasters (score = a + b*D/1000 + c*collar); the packing multiplier assumes the kmass/dot gain transfers fully (or half) into TP. This is a PROJECTION, not a score.
projection.headline: 0.285 (base, regression only) to 0.332 (upside, full packing transfer); 0.308 central
projection.caution: Dot count and packing efficiency are 98% collinear across the registry (r=-0.980), so the registry cannot separate the two mechanisms. The base case uses the regression alone, which already absorbs whatever packing effect exists inside the fitted range.

verdict_reason: Passes every locally checkable gate; is distinct from all nine focus rasters by a wide margin; and applies the only improvement in the registry that is both unused and provable. The score remains a PROJECTION (0.285-0.332) because no organizer receipt exists and the hidden truth is unavailable.
limitations: All nine live scores are user-reported; no organizer receipt ties any score to exact bytes.
The projection extrapolates a 9-point regression below its fitted range and assumes the packing gain transfers to TP.
No design in this evidence reaches 0.32-0.44; the published family plateaus at 0.25-0.278.
The catalogue holdout is anti-correlated with the target and was not used to select this design.
Organizer portal acceptance is untested from this environment.
